# Mercury Partners

> Mercury Partners is a San Diego-based principal investment firm, founded in 1996 and led by Founding Partner Brad de Koning. It invests its own permanent capital in founder-owned business services and healthcare services companies in the United States.

Mercury Partners is not a traditional private equity fund. It invests its own capital, has no fund life or forced exit timeline, and can own businesses indefinitely. Brad de Koning has been both a private equity investor and CEO of two lower middle market companies, most recently DirectMed Imaging, which Mercury acquired in 2017 and grew through organic initiatives and seven add-on acquisitions.

## Investment criteria

- Revenue: $10 million to $50 million
- EBITDA: $1 million to $4 million
- Transaction size: $5 million to $50 million
- Geography: United States
- Ownership: founder-owned businesses
- Transaction types: majority or control investments, founder transitions and recapitalizations, management buyouts, strategic add-on acquisitions
- Business characteristics: critical services to complex or regulated end markets, technical expertise, high barriers to entry, recurring or non-discretionary demand, meaningful switching costs, fragmented competitive landscape

## Sectors

- Business services: equipment maintenance and repair; testing, inspection, and calibration; facilities management; specialty field services; safety and compliance
- Healthcare services: medical equipment maintenance and repair; healthcare equipment testing and calibration; medical products and distribution; healthcare facility support services; sterilization and infection control

## Representative investments

DirectMed Imaging, LBN Medical, Medical Systems Tech, Richardson Healthcare, ScanMed, Technical Prospects, Titanium Medical Imaging, and one undisclosed diagnostic imaging parts provider.
